experiment.dataset_description: 110 clean controls plus deterministic formatting/repetition variants. Variants are synthetic realistic-style perturbations, not observations from real users; source prompts require native-speaker review.
experiment.semantic_preservation: Not established by token counts or text normalization. No repeated query/context is deleted; candidate removal remains gated on evaluation.

external_evaluation.answer_system_prompt: Answer the user's question accurately and concisely in the language used by the user.
external_evaluation.pairing: Each technique result has a stable evaluation_pair_id and retains the unchanged original_query.
external_evaluation.note: The dataset is not sent to any external model by this experiment.

unicode_nfc.description: Apply unicode nfc to the original query only.

horizontal_whitespace.description: Apply horizontal whitespace to the original query only.

outer_whitespace_trim.description: Apply outer whitespace trim to the original query only.

blank_line_compaction.description: Apply blank line compaction to the original query only.

combined_safe_normalization.description: Apply combined safe normalization to the original query only.

repetition_detection_only.description: Detect exact repeated question segments; leave text unchanged because repetition can express emphasis or intent.
